sloka: ततः सहस्रनयनः प्रीतियुक्तः शुभाननः ।कुशेशयमयीं मालामुत्क्षिप्येदं वचो ऽब्रवीत् ।। ७.३६.१० ॥
transliteration: tataḥ sahasranayanaḥ prītiyuktaḥ śubhānanaḥ ।kuśeśayamayīṁ mālāmutkṣipyedaṁ vaco 'bravīt ।। 7.36.10 ॥

translations.english: Then, Indra, the thousand-eyed god, filled with joy and having an auspicious face, lifted up a lotus garland and spoke these words.
